description: Structured educational reference data for negative ion wellness devices, negative ion pendants, air ionization context, responsible product-use framing, and related Holistix negative ion resources.
medical_disclaimer: This dataset is for educational and informational purposes only. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, cure, prevention, or a substitute for professional healthcare guidance. Anyone with a medical condition, implanted medical device, pregnancy, prescription medication use, or uncertainty about whether a wellness device is appropriate should consult a qualified healthcare professional before use.

records.plain_language_summary: Negative ion wellness products should be kept away from children and pets unless the product instructions clearly allow otherwise.

records.safety_framing: Follow product storage, charging, and handling instructions. Use common-sense household safety.

records.educational_notes: Claims should focus on product category, responsible use, and general wellness education where appropriate.
records.safety_framing: Avoid disease-treatment claims and unsupported medical promises.

records.plain_language_summary: Negative ion wearable devices should be maintained and handled according to product instructions.
